headline: D4vd案律師團退出
context: 美國歌手 D4vd 被控殺害、性侵並肢解 14 歲少女賽勒斯特．里瓦斯（Celeste Rivas Hernandez），他的私人律師團隊本週一退出案件，之後改由洛杉磯公設辯護人代理，D4vd 也在庭訊中再度否認全部罪名。同一天，英國電視圈則有一部重演真實案件的紀實影集回歸，內容是一名青少年因謀殺案受審的過程。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Singer, accused of murder and sexual abuse of teen Celeste Rivas Hernandez, to be represented by LA public defender Singer D4vd lost his high-profile private lawyers on Monday at a hearing where he entered a new not guilty plea to charges that he killed, sexually abused and dismembered 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. It is not clear why Blair Berk and her colleagues Marilyn Bednarski and Regina Peter parted ways with the singer, whose legal name is David Anthony Burke. They were replaced by a lawyer from the Los Angeles county public defender’s office. Continue reading...
sources.title: Defense lawyers for singer D4vd withdraw from murder case

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The gripping series about controversial real-life verdicts returns. Plus: The Great British Sewing Bee gets bookish. Here’s what to watch today 9pm, Channel 4 With trial by jury under scrutiny , this is a timely moment for the return of this gripping series, which reruns an actual criminal trial and follows the 12 jury members as they reach their verdict. This time, the case of brothers – one of whom is only 14 years old – accused of killing their stepfather causes instant polarisation. Debates around nature and nurture and punishment for its own sake emerge straight away. Phil Harrison Continue reading...
sources.title: TV tonight: join the jury as a teenager goes on trial for murder
